items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The mention of Joe Glaser occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn describing a trip to Japan with 'him' (presumably Louis Armstrong, given the context of 'Doc Schiff' and 'entourage'). The interviewee, Danny Barker, does not mention Joe Glaser, nor does he respond to the mention with any per

ctx.x: I was with him when he went to Japan, and he had probably been every place in the world except Japan. And everybody went with him. Joe Glaser, Doc Schiff, the whole entourage. This was his first trip to Japan, and the people were all prepared for him. Man, when you want to see him, see him play some place where he's never been before. Because he's really... Now, he was gettin' to be a old man and a little tired. Man, he rose to such an occasion, playin' for them people, that I found myself standing with the bass…
